question: Find the account ID of the oldest female client (earliest birth date) who has an account in any district that has at least one active loan (status 'C' or 'D'), and return the difference between the highest and lowest average salaries across all districts.

prediction.sql:
SELECT T1."XCL_001", (SELECT MAX("XCL_027") - MIN("XCL_027") FROM district) AS diff
FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_015"
INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3."XCL_014" = T4."XCL_009"
WHERE T4."XCL_010" = 'F'
  AND T2."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT T2b."XCL_017"
    FROM account AS T1b
    INNER JOIN district AS T2b ON T1b."XCL_002" = T2b."XCL_017"
    INNER JOIN loan AS T5 ON T1b."XCL_001" = T5."XCL_034"
    WHERE T5."XCL_039" IN ('C','D')
  )
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" ASC
LIMIT 1

FROM account AS T1
INNER JOIN district AS T2 ON T1."XCL_002" = T2."XCL_017"
INNER JOIN disp AS T3 ON T1."XCL_001" = T3."XCL_015"
INNER JOIN client AS T4 ON T3."XCL_014" = T4."XCL_009"
WHERE T4."XCL_010" = 'F'
  AND T2."XCL_017" IN (
    SELECT T2b."XCL_017"
    FROM account AS T1b
    INNER JOIN district AS T2b ON T1b."XCL_002" = T2b."XCL_017"
    INNER JOIN loan AS T5 ON T1b."XCL_001" = T5."XCL_034"
    WHERE T5."XCL_039" IN ('C','D')
  )
ORDER BY T4."XCL_011" ASC

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    a.XCL_001 AS account_id,
    (
        SELECT MAX(avg_salary) - MIN(avg_salary)
        FROM (
            SELECT AVG(d.XCL_029) AS avg_salary
            FROM district d
        )
    ) AS salary_difference
FROM client c
JOIN disp d ON c.XCL_009 = d.XCL_014
JOIN account a ON d.XCL_015 = a.XCL_001
JOIN district dist ON a.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
WHERE c.XCL_010 = 'F'
  AND EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM loan l
      JOIN account la ON l.XCL_034 = la.XCL_001
      WHERE la.XCL_002 = dist.XCL_017
        AND l.XCL_039 IN ('C', 'D')
  )
ORDER BY c.XCL_011 ASC
LIMIT 1
